faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to violate any of the provisions of this article,
               and any such violation shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed of
section 1-5
and as set forth herein.
(b)
Any person who violates any provision of this article shall be guilty of a petty offense,
               punishable by:
(1)
A minimum fine of $200.00 for the first violation.
(2)
A minimum fine of $300.00 for the second violation.
(3)
A minimum fine of $500.00 for each additional violation of this article.
(c)
Every day any violation of this article is committed or permitted to continue shall
               constitute a separate offense punishable as set forth herein.
(
Ord. No. 4392, § 2, 7-1-2013
)
